_meta.description: Category codes (MCCs) reported online for merchants in data/merchants.prefill.json. Status 'reported' = published by a third party, not confirmed by her statement.

sources.moneysmart: MoneySmart, 'Guide To Popular Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) in Singapore', updated Jan 2026 (checked by the author against Mastercard's list and WhatCard/HeyMax). Preferred source.
sources.mccexplorer: MCC Explorer, Singapore MCC Codes Guide (accessed 30 Sep 2026). Generic lookup site; disagrees with MoneySmart on several merchants. Used only where MoneySmart has no entry.
sources.heymax: HeyMax blog, 'Understanding MCCs in Singapore', Apr 2025.
sources.milelion: The MileLion, Visa Supplier Locator article (GrabPay top-up codes).
sources.ocbc365: OCBC 365 Card cashback T&Cs (1 Aug 2023): defines dining as 5811/5812, plus foodpanda, GrabFood and Deliveroo when they code under those or 5814.

warnings: There is no official public list matching Singapore merchants to codes. Codes are set by each merchant's payment processor, can differ between Visa and Mastercard, between outlets, and over time.
Where sources disagree, 'mcc' is the preferred source's code and 'alt_mccs' lists the others.
Merchants not listed here had no reliable published code; keep their category default and let the statement check confirm them.
